'''Huttese pilot's workgloves''' were an item of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] handwear designed for pilots worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were consisted of a [[black]] glove with a metallic control panel attached. Whether they were made by the [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] species or simply named for them is unknown.
